manifest.name: dsh-study-notes
manifest.description: Study-notes skill provider: plan a syllabus and teach a subject as 3–5 mini-lessons per section (question → think → explain with the maths → hands-on practice → read back), where each lesson grows one runnable artifact from an empty project, with a replay checker, teaching-line lint, Typora 1.14 math compatibility lint, offline KaTeX for the local web portal, and gradable tests.

scripts.test: node test/verify-plugin.mjs && node test/check-fixture.mjs && node test/run-sample.mjs

manifest.author: GamecialX <gamecialkaiju@gmail.com>

bundle.text:
# Bundle patch for dsh-study-notes.
#
# One Host row provides the `study-notes` skill through the skill registry
# (`ctx.skills`). It declares no dependencies, so it resolves offline and needs
# no build step.
- insert:
    - id: study-notes
      name: 'dsh-study-notes'

readme.text:
**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/GamecialX/dsh-study-notes)

一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件（bundle），它往当前 profile 里注册一个技能：

> **`study-notes`** —— 当用户想从零学一门科目、想要"学习笔记 / 教学文档 / 讲义 / 教材式笔记"时，
> 指导 agent 生成**一门能从头跟到尾的课**，而不是一本概念百科：每一节在读者自己的 `project/`
> （非代码科目是推导本、句子本、时间线……）里长出一个能检查的产物，下一节接着上一节的产物往下做；
> 概念在第一次用到它的那一步里出现。配套有图、每节 3–5 道练习、本章速查、100 分制章末测试（含跨章回顾），
> 以及一个本地的网页学习门户（单文件应用 + 一键启动脚本）。笔记是 Typora 优先的**标准 Markdown**。
> 新课程会先写一节样章，等用户确认风格后再批量生成。

零依赖、零构建、可离线安装。`index.js` 只 import `node:` 内置模块。

---

| 产物 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `00 大纲.md` | 全库总起页：科目简介、**怎么跟这门课**、逐章逐节的「本节产物 / 动手入口」、概念检索表（检索用，正课顺着读） |
| `Cha_X 章名/` | 每章：节笔记（`## 接上一节` → 3–5 个 `## 第 N 步：` → 小结 → 练习，概念以 `### 概念 N：` 出现在第一次用到它的那一步里）、`CX 速查.md`、`CX 测试.md`、`src/` 图源；最后一节有章末通跑和本章项目地图 |
| `project/`（读者的） | 读者自己动手的工程，从空目录开始，照正文的【新建】/【修改】/【重构】/【收口】/【运行】一步步长出来；agent 不往里放东西 |
| `code/`（答案与证据，代码类科目） | `code/answer/chNN/`：第 N 章做完时 `project/` 应有的样子；`code/out/`：每次【运行】的真实输出（`<!-- output: -->` 绑定）；`code/notebooks/CN_*.ipynb`：演示用 notebook（不带输出） || `checklist.md` | 工作记录：规划表、进度指针、恢复上下文（含样章确认的风格约定）、变更日志 |
| `web/index.html` | 单文件学习门户（黑色机械风 × 毛玻璃，内联全部 CSS/JS） |
| `web/vendor/katex/` | 离线公式引擎（KaTeX 0.16.22，约 1.3 MB；断网也能排版公式） |
| `web/notes_data.js` | 目录结构与题目数据（正文不复制，前端实时 fetch `.md`） |
| `web/serve.mjs` | 零依赖 Node 静态服务器（只在探测不到 Python 时使用） |
| `启动学习服务器.bat`、`start_server.sh` | 一键起服务器并自动打开门户 |

门户的能力：仪表盘进度与均分、侧栏导航树、标注块（`> *Note*` 等 5 种）渲染为彩色框且答案默认折叠、 标题锚点与标准 `.md` 链接跳转、本章速查页、公式（KaTeX 随门户离线分发，断网也能排版；本地副本缺失时自动回退 CDN）、节内练习即时判分、 章末整卷测试与成绩单（客观题自动判分、主观题按评分要点自评、保留最佳与最近成绩）、知识图谱、全文搜索、 `localStorage` 持久化。 ---

插件包就是**这个仓库的根目录**（含 `package.json` 的那一层）。DSH 从**本地绝对路径**安装它，所以先把仓库克隆到本机：

```bash
git clone git@github.com:GamecialX/dsh-study-notes.git

readme.section: 没配 SSH 就走 HTTPS：
readme.text:
git clone https://github.com/GamecialX/dsh-study-notes.git
```

下面把这个目录的绝对路径记作 `<插件目录>`，三种装法选一种。

readme.section: 方式 A：Web 界面（推荐）
readme.text:
1. 打开 DSH 的 Web 界面，左侧栏点 **Plugins**。
2. 点 **Add plugin**，在输入框里填 `<插件目录>` 的**绝对路径**，例如
   - Windows：`C:\Users\<你的用户名>\dsh-study-notes`
   - macOS / Linux：`/Users/<你的用户名>/dsh-study-notes`
3. 点 **Install**。安装完成后 bundle 默认是启用状态，本插件的那一行（id 为 `study-notes`）也会启用。

路径必须是绝对路径，且指向**含有 `package.json` 的那一层**（也就是仓库根目录）。

readme.section: 方式 B：让 agent 装
readme.text:
在一个启用了 `plugin_manager` 工具的会话（Creator 模式）里说：

> 用 plugin_manager 的 install_bundle，把 `<插件目录>` 装到当前 profile。

每个 `plugin_manager` 动作在非完全权限模式下都需要批准，这是正常现象。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile 名> add "<插件目录>"
```

- 侧栏 **Plugins** 页面里能看到 **Study notes (学习笔记)** 卡片（标题与描述来自 `locale/`，图标来自 `icon.svg`）。
- 新开会话时，会话技能目录里出现 `study-notes`。
- 在会话里说一句「我想从零学 <某科目>，给我生成学习笔记」，agent 应当加载 `study-notes` 并先向你确认科目与目的——这就是它生效了。

> **注意**：如果是通过 `pnpm add <本地路径>` 安装的，profile 里记的通常是**符号链接**，
> 指向本目录。**不要移动或删除这个目录**，否则插件会失效（表现为 skill 消失或资源路径读不到）。

---

```
dsh-study-notes/
├── package.json           # 声明 dsh.bundle.patch；无依赖、无 peerDependencies
├── cordis.patch.yml       # insert 一行：id=study-notes, name=dsh-study-notes
├── index.js               # Host 插件：解析 SKILL.md 并把 skill 注册进 ctx.skills

---
```bash

readme.section: 1) 插件层：语法、skill provider 契约、门户渲染器与判分函数、模板行尾、资产清单
readme.text: node test/verify-plugin.mjs

readme.section: 非代码样章（数学推导本，没有 project/）在 --strict 下 0 error，3 种缺陷能被抓到
readme.text: node test/check-fixture.mjs

readme.section: 执行每一条【运行】并比对保存的输出（需要 Python 3；找不到时跳过并返回 0）
readme.text: node test/run-sample.mjs

npm test
```

`test/fixtures/progressive-ch1/` 是一门完整的「第 1 章」样章（从零手搓自动求导：数值导数 → 会自己反向传播的 `Value`），
它同时是新结构的参考样本：看它就知道一节「接上一节 → 第 N 步 → 留给下一节」长什么样、
代码块标签怎么写、`code/answer/ch01/` 和照做出来的 `project/` 怎样一一对应。
改了样章正文后用 `node test/run-sample.mjs --write` 重新生成它的输出与答案快照。

`verify-plugin.mjs` 会在**无浏览器**环境里启动门户脚本（用一个极小的 DOM stub），
通过门户暴露的 `window.__NOTES_PORTAL__` 调试出口直接调用 Markdown 渲染器与判分函数，
所以渲染回归、标注块与答案折叠、标题锚点、标准链接解析、图片路径解析、`$公式$` 降级这些都能自动验证。

浏览器里的**视觉**效果（毛玻璃、动效、响应式布局）无法自动验证——那部分需要人眼看。

---

readme.section: 五、校验生成出来的学习库
readme.text:
```bash
node assets/study-notes/scripts/check-library.mjs "<笔记根目录>"                    # 默认：课程线规则只报 warning
node assets/study-notes/scripts/check-library.mjs "<笔记根目录>" --strict           # 新库验收：课程线规则升为 error
node assets/study-notes/scripts/check-library.mjs "<笔记根目录>" --only "<相对路径>"  # 单篇（样章阶段，可重复）
node assets/study-notes/scripts/check-library.mjs "<笔记根目录>" --json

`check-library.mjs` 退出码 `0` = 无 error（可能有 warning），`1` = 有 error，`2` = 用法错误。它检查：

readme.section: 五、校验生成出来的学习库
readme.text:
- **结构**：命名规范、frontmatter、必备产物、每章测试（error）与速查（warning）；跳过 `_`、`.` 开头的目录。
- **链接**：标准链接与图片是否存在、锚点能否对上标题（容忍 Typora/GitHub 的符号差异）、空链接、越出根目录的链接、未编码空格。
- **可移植**：`[[wikilink]]` / `![[嵌入]]` = error；`> [!x]` callout、`> **Note**:`、单行 `$$`、多 H1 = warning。
- **教学**：每节练习 3–5 题（只数「本节练习」里的答案块）、篇幅 ≤ 800 行、标注块 ≤ 20、旧式 `C1-01` 编号残留、第 3 章起测试的 `【回顾 CX】` 题。
- **代码**：`<!-- source: -->` / `<!-- output: -->` 绑定的片段逐行对照真实文件；写了「真实输出」却没绑定 = warning。
- **课程线 [R1]–[R12]**（默认 warning，`--strict` 时 error）：
  - [R1] 节内顺序是 导读 → 接上一节 → 3–5 步 → 小结 → 练习 → 概念索引，每一步都有「动作 → 可见结果 → 为什么」；
  - [R2] `## 接上一节`（上一节做到 / 留下的坑 / 本节补上）和节末的「留给下一节」；
  - [R3] 概念是步骤里的节点（`### 概念 N：` 或被两步包夹的 `## 概念 N：`），全库统一一种写法；
  - [R4] 代码块带【新建】/【修改】(diff)/【重构】/【收口】标签、路径在 `project/` 下、不许「节选」和省略行；
    照正文从空目录重放必须成功，章末结果与 `code/answer/chNN/` 同构；不许引用晚于本章的答案或 notebook；读者不在 `code/` 里动手；
  - [R5] 导读写清「你现在手上」和「本节结束时」；[R6] 章末通跑（一条命令 + 真实输出）；[R7] 章末项目地图（非代码科目是产物目录，不要求 `project/`）；
  - [R8] notebook 放 `code/notebooks/CN_*.ipynb` 且不带输出；[R10] 每节 3–5 步、预计 30–100 分钟；
  - [R11] 正文、命令、输出里没有本机绝对路径。
  - [R12] 公式里没有 `\mathbb`：Typora 1.14 内置 MathJax 4，同步渲染路径上 `\mathbb` 会整条退回源码（读者以为公式坏了）。花体字母写 unicode（`ℝ` `ℕ` `ℤ` `ℚ` `ℂ` `𝔼`），指示函数写 `\mathbf{1}`；批量替换 `templates/fix-mathbb

readme.section: 五、校验生成出来的学习库
readme.text:
`run-course.mjs` 是「顺读测试」的机器版：它调用 `check-library.mjs --replay-to` 得到每次【运行】时的 `project/`，
在里面执行命令（stdout 与 stderr 合并），去掉本机绝对路径后与 `code/out/` 比对；比对时忽略回溯栈帧和耗时。
找不到 Python 时它跳过并返回 0。**它会执行笔记里的命令，只对自己写的库运行。**

这两个脚本证明的是**机械一致性**和「照做能跑通」，证明不了**知识正确性**，
也证明不了「读者知不知道下一步干什么」——后者按 `assets/study-notes/references/quality-gates.md`
和 `teaching-design.md` 第十二节的人工顺读测试过。

v2.0.0 的 R1–R11 保证的是「读者能照着做出来」。实测发现这还不够：一节读完，读者可能只是在**跟着别人的代码走**，
说得出"下一步新建哪个文件"，说不出"为什么要这个函数、为什么非这样写"。v2.1 因此补了一组讲解线规则：

| 规则 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| T1 先讲后做 | 每一步的标题是一个问题或知识主题（「为什么一批数不能是 Python 列表」）；动手之前至少 8 行（通常 20–60 行）讲清为什么要做这一步、为什么非这样写 |
| T2 概念讲透 | `### 概念 N` 条目 40–120 行：为什么需要它 → 原理/数学上的说法 → 一句话 → 定义 → 例子 → 易错点；不是 API 卡片 |
| T3 先想再看 | 每节至少一处「先想一下 / 先猜一猜」，揭晓后必须解释猜错的人错在哪 |
| T4 回看 | 每步跑完有「刚才发生了什么」，把输出逐条对回讲解 |
| T5 讲解为主 | 正文不少于代码：代码是实践环节，不是骨架 |

**重要：T1–T5 在 2.1 版一律只报 warning，`--strict` 也不升 error。** 理由是本仓库的 fixture 和老库都还是
"操作手册"式讲法，一上来就强制会让迁移寸步难行。写新库时请把它们当硬要求执行；
等 fixtures 全部改写成四拍讲法后，下一版再收紧。

模板 `templates/section-note.md` 与 `references/teaching-design.md` 已按四拍（想 → 讲 → 做 → 看）重写，
新库照模板写就自然满足 T1–T5。

---

readme.section: 六、老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移
readme.text:
v2.0.0 之前生成的库是「概念卡片」骨架：每节由若干 `## 概念 N：` 排成，代码从写好的 `code/` 成品里摘「节选」。
新版校验器对这类库**不报新的 error**，只把课程线问题列成 `[R*]` warning，所以可以一节一节地迁，不必一次推倒。
用本仓库实测的三座老库（只读、默认模式）作参照：都是 0 error，课程线 warning 分别约 370、220、250 条。

**迁移前**：先把库提交到 git（或整体备份）。迁移会大面积改正文，出了问题要能回到原样。

**第 0 步：看清欠账。**

```bash
node assets/study-notes/scripts/check-library.mjs "<库>" --json > before.json
```

按 `[R*]` 编号数一数，知道问题主要集中在哪些规则、哪些章。

**第 1 步：先修零成本的。** 这几类改动不碰教学结构，可以全库一次做完：

readme.section: 六、老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移
readme.text:
- [R11] 本机绝对路径：正文、命令、保存的输出里的 `C:\Users\…`、`D:\…`、`/home/…` 换成相对笔记根目录或 `project/` 的写法；
  脚本打印路径的，改成先转相对路径再打印，然后重新生成输出。
- [R8] notebook：挪到 `code/notebooks/CN_主题.ipynb`，清空输出。
- 门户公式：把 `templates/web/index.html` 与整个 `templates/web/vendor/` 复制进 `<库>/web/`。
  只复制 `index.html` 也能用，但断网时公式会退化成源码；带上 `vendor/`（约 1.3 MB）才是真正离线可读。

**第 2 步：按章迁移，从第 1 章开始往后。** 承接链是从前往后的，第 N 章的「接上一节」依赖第 N−1 章已经迁好。每一章：

readme.section: 六、老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移
readme.text: 1. **先定线（R9）**：在 `00 大纲.md` 和 `checklist.md` 里给本章每一节写「本节产物」——这一节结束时读者手上多了什么、能检查什么。 写不出来的节，说明它本来就是概念卡片，要并进别的节或重新切分。 2. **改节骨架（R1/R2/R5/R10）**：每节加 `## 接上一节`（上一节做到：/ 留下的坑：/ 本节补上：）， 导读写「你现在手上 / 本节结束时」，正文切成 3–5 个 `## 第 N 步：`，每步写清动作、可见结果、为什么，节末加 留给下一节：。超过 800 行或超过 5 步的节拆成两节。 3. **把概念挪进步骤（R3）**：`## 概念 N：名称` 改成 `### 概念 N：名称`，放进第一次需要它的那一步里。 **编号保留**：门户的概念徽标和锚点靠「概念 N：」定位，去掉编号会断链。迁移中途全库混用 `##` 与 `###` 会报一条 [R3]「全库混用」warning，这是预期的，迁完就消失。 4. **把成品代码变成读者自己的代码（R4）**： - 现在的 `code/` 是全书最终版。把**本章结束时**应有的状态放进 `code/answer/chNN/`——要剥掉后面章节才加的类和函数， 否则就是把未来版本泄漏给了读者； - 正文代码块改成带标签的操作：【新建】`project/…`（完整文件）、【修改】`project/…`（```diff 块，留上下文行）、 【重构】`project/…`（按函数名整体替换）、【收口】、【运行】（命令代码块）；删掉所有「节选」和 `...` 省略行； - 让读者在 `code/` 里建目录、写文件的命令（如 `mkdir -p code/xxx`）都改到 `project/`。 5. **生成真实输出和答案快照**： bash node assets/study-notes/scripts/run-course.mjs "<库>" --write ```

readme.section: 六、老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移
readme.text:
它会从空目录照正文做一遍、执行每条【运行】，写出 `code/out/`、正文里的输出块和 `code/answer/chNN/`。
   读一遍生成的输出：**和正文说法不一样时改正文，不改输出**。重放失败（某个【修改】找不到上下文）说明正文本身照做不通，按报告的行号修。
6. **补章末（R6/R7）**：本章最后一节加一步「章末通跑」（一条命令 + 绑定的真实输出），再加「本章项目地图」
   （包含 `project/` 的文件树、每个文件一句话职责、「本章动了」哪些文件）。
7. **本章验收**：对本章每一节跑 `check-library.mjs "<库>" --strict --only "<本章各节>"`，再跑一次 `run-course.mjs "<库>"`。
   本章 0 error、输出全部一致，才算这一章迁完，记进 `checklist.md` 的变更日志。

readme.section: 六、老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移
readme.text:
**第 2 步补充：把讲解补厚（T1–T5）。** 只改结构、不改讲解，会得到一堆"能照做但学不到东西"的节——
这正是 v2.1 要解决的问题。补法不碰代码、不动输出，可以先跑一遍 `check-library.mjs` 看 `[T1]`–`[T5]` 的 warning 定位：

- 每步标题从文件操作改成问题（「新建 check.py」→「先想清楚：为什么"一批数"不能是 Python 列表」）；
- 每步动手前补 2–5 段"为什么现在要做这个、为什么非这样写"，把刚才的结构说明升级成讲解；
- 概念条目从 15–40 行扩到 40–120 行，补「为什么需要它」和"它在数学/原理上是什么"；
- 每节挑一处改成先想后看（先抛问题、让读者自己答，再揭晓）；每步输出后加「刚才发生了什么」，逐条对回讲解。

readme.section: 六、老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移
readme.text:
**第 3 步：全库验收。** 所有章迁完后跑 `check-library.mjs "<库>" --strict` 和 `run-course.mjs "<库>"`，两者都通过即迁移完成。
最后挑一章做一次人工顺读测试（只按正文字面指示，在空的 `project/` 里照做到章末）。

**非代码科目**（数学、语言、历史……）没有 `project/` 和 `code/`，[R4]/[R6] 的代码部分不适用。
迁移照样走第 2 步的 1–3、6：每节的产物换成推导本里多出的一条结论、句子本里多出的一组句型、时间线上多出的一段，
章末通跑换成「从头验算 / 复述一遍自己的产物」。分科目的写法见 `assets/study-notes/references/subject-playbooks.md`。

---

- **无外部依赖**：`index.js`、`serve.mjs`、`check-library.mjs`、`run-course.mjs` 只使用 `node:` 内置模块。
  因此 `package.json` 里没有 `dependencies`，也没有 `peerDependencies`——安装时不会触发任何
  网络请求，也不会被 profile 的 DSH 版本兼容性检查拒绝。
- **`inject = ['skills']`**：profile 里没有 skill 注册表时，插件安静地保持 inactive，而不是抛错。
- **`SKILL.md` 自解析**：插件读取 `assets/*/SKILL.md` 的 YAML frontmatter，取出 `name` 与
  `description` 作为目录条目；`SKILL.md` 是唯一的元信息来源，不会与别处漂移。
  新增技能只需在 `assets/` 下多放一个含 `SKILL.md` 的目录。
- **`resourceBase` 暴露真实目录**：技能加载时，`skill` 工具会告诉模型
  `references/`、`templates/`、`scripts/` 的绝对路径。模型用 shell 复制大文件
  （门户 HTML、启动脚本）而不是重新打一遍，既省上下文又不会抄错字节。
- **启动脚本的端口探测**：`.bat` 用 `for /f` 收集 `netstat` 里 **LISTENING** 的行来判断端口是否被占用。
  不能只看 `":8765 "`——`TIME_WAIT` 连接里同一个数字会出现在本地或远端端口列，会被误判为占用；
  也不能依赖管道之后的 `errorlevel`，cmd 在管道里传递它的方式不可靠。

- 门户的**视觉效果**没有被自动化测试覆盖（无浏览器控制），需要人工确认。
- `check-library.mjs` 对 `CX 测试.md` 的题号/分值是按 `**N.（M 分）**` 这一约定格式统计的。
  如果测试文件用了别的格式，它会退化为一条 warning（"无法自动核对"），而不是误报。
- `notes_data.js` 与 `.md` 的题目一致性只能做**宽松**核对（题干前 10 个实义字、分值序列、题目数量）。
  语义等价但措辞不同的题目不会被发现。
- `run-course.mjs` 用系统 shell 执行【运行】命令（开头的 `python` / `python3` 会换成探测到或 `--python` 指定的解释器），单条命令超时 120 秒，
  按「去掉快照绝对路径、忽略回溯栈帧与 unittest 耗时」的口径比对。依赖未固定的随机数、网络或 GPU 的输出会被判为不一致：
  这类步骤要么固定种子，要么写成 ```` ```text ```` 的示意并说明。
- 概念标题保留编号（`### 概念 N：名称`），因为门户的概念徽标按「概念 N：」生成锚点；不带编号的概念标题不会被门户识别。
- 课程线规则能查出「结构上像不像一门课」，查不出「读者读到这里知不知道下一步干什么」，后者仍靠人工顺读测试。
- 安装后如果移动了本插件目录，符号链接会断掉，需要重新安装。

[](https://github.com/GamecialX/dsh-study-notes)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin (bundle) that registers one skill into the current profile:

> **`study-notes`** — when the user wants to learn a subject from zero and asks for "study notes / teaching docs / a handout / textbook-style notes", it drives the agent to build **a course you can follow from top to bottom**, not a concept encyclopedia: every section grows one checkable artifact in the reader's own `project/` (for non-programming subjects: a derivation notebook, a sentence book, a timeline…), the next section continues from it, and each concept appears inside the step that first needs it. It comes with figures, 3–5 exercises per section, a per-chapter cheat sheet, a 100-point chapter test with cross-chapter review, and a local web learning portal (single-file app plus a one-click launcher). Notes are Typora-first **standard Markdown**. For a brand-new course the agent writes **one sample section first** and waits for the user to confirm the style before generating the rest.

Zero dependencies, no build step, installs offline. `index.js` imports only `node:` built-ins.

---
Once `study-notes` is loaded, the agent produces the following under the notes root the user picks:

| Artifact | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `00 大纲.md` | Whole-library entry page: subject overview, **how to follow this course**, per-section "artifact / where you start typing", and a concept lookup table (for lookup only; the course itself is read in order) |
| `Cha_X 章名/` | Per chapter: section notes (`## 接上一节` → 3–5 `## 第 N 步：` steps → summary → exercises, with concepts as `### 概念 N：` inside the step that first needs them), `CX 速查.md`, `CX 测试.md`, `src/` diagram sources; the last section has a chapter smoke run and a project map |
| `project/` (the reader's) | The reader's own workspace. It starts empty and grows step by step through the labels 【新建】 (create) / 【修改】 (diff) / 【重构】 (replace by name) / 【收口】 (wrap up) / 【运行】 (run); the agent never puts anything in it |
| `code/` (answers and evidence, code-heavy subjects) | `code/answer/chNN/`: what `project/` should look like after chapter N; `code/out/`: the real output of every 【运行】 (bound with `<!-- output: -->`); `code/notebooks/CN_*.ipynb`: demo notebooks without outputs || `checklist.md` | Working record: plan table, progress pointer, recovery context (including the confirmed sample-section conventions), changelog |
| `web/index.htm

The portal provides: dashboard progress and average score, sidebar navigation tree, five kinds of callout rendered as coloured boxes with answers collapsed by default, heading anchors and standard `.md` links, a per-chapter cheat-sheet view, formulas (KaTeX ships with the portal, so they render offline; if the local copy is missing it falls back to the CDN), instant grading of in-section exercises, full chapter tests with a report card (objective questions auto-graded, subjective ones self-scored against the rubric, best and latest attempts kept), a knowledge graph, full-text search, and `localStorage` persistence.

The plugin package **is the repository root** (the directory containing `package.json`). DSH installs plugins from a **local absolute path**, so clone the repository first:

```bash
git clone git@github.com:GamecialX/dsh-study-notes.git

readme.section: or over HTTPS if you have no SSH key set up:
readme.text:
git clone https://github.com/GamecialX/dsh-study-notes.git
```

Below, `<plugin-dir>` stands for the absolute path of that directory. Pick one of the three install routes.

1. Open the DSH web UI and click **Plugins** in the left sidebar.
2. Click **Add plugin** and enter the **absolute path** of `<plugin-dir>`, for example
   - Windows: `C:\Users\<you>\dsh-study-notes`
   - macOS / Linux: `/Users/<you>/dsh-study-notes`
3. Click **Install**. The bundle is enabled by default, and the plugin's own row (id `study-notes`) is enabled with it.

The path must be absolute and must point at the level that contains `package.json` — that is, the repository root.

readme.section: Option B: Let the agent install it
readme.text:
In a session that has the `plugin_manager` tool (Creator mode), say:

> Use plugin_manager's install_bundle to install `<plugin-dir>` into the current profile.

Every `plugin_manager` action needs approval outside full-permission mode; that is expected.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile-name> add "<plugin-dir>"
```

- The **Plugins** page shows a **Study notes (学习笔记)** card (title and description come from `locale/`, the icon from `icon.svg`).
- A new session's skill catalogue lists `study-notes`.
- Saying "I want to learn <subject> from scratch, generate study notes for me" makes the agent load `study-notes` and confirm subject and goal with you first — that means it works.

> **Note**: if it was installed via `pnpm add <local-path>`, the profile usually records a **symlink** to this directory. **Do not move or delete this directory**, or the plugin breaks (the skill disappears or asset paths stop resolving).

---

```
dsh-study-notes/
├── package.json           # declares dsh.bundle.patch; no dependencies, no peerDependencies
├── cordis.patch.yml       # inserts one row: id=study-notes, name=dsh-study-notes
├── index.js               # host plugin: parses SKILL.md and registers the skill into ctx.skills

---
```bash

readme.text: node test/verify-plugin.mjs

readme.section: has 0 errors under --strict and 3 injected defects are caught
readme.text: node test/check-fixture.mjs

readme.section: directory, run every 【运行】 and compare with the saved output (needs Python 3; skipped with exit 0 if missing)
readme.text: node test/run-sample.mjs

npm test

`test/fixtures/progressive-ch1/` is a complete "chapter 1" (autodiff from scratch: numerical derivatives → a `Value` that backpropagates by itself). It doubles as the reference sample of the new structure: it shows what a "接上一节 → 第 N 步 → 留给下一节" section looks like, how code labels are written, and how `code/answer/ch01/` matches the `project/` you get by following the text. After editing the sample, regenerate its outputs and answer snapshot with `node test/run-sample.mjs --write`.

`verify-plugin.mjs` boots the portal script in a **headless** environment (a tiny DOM stub) and calls the Markdown renderer and the grading functions directly through the portal's `window.__NOTES_PORTAL__` debug hook. That makes rendering regressions, callouts and answer collapsing, heading anchors, standard-link resolution, image path resolution and `$formula$` fallback all automatically verifiable.

What cannot be verified automatically is how the portal **looks** in a real browser (frosted glass, motion, responsive layout) — that needs human eyes.

---

```bash
node assets/study-notes/scripts/check-library.mjs "<notes-root>"                      # default: course rules are warnings
node assets/study-notes/scripts/check-library.mjs "<notes-root>" --strict             # acceptance for new libraries: course rules become errors
node assets/study-notes/scripts/check-library.mjs "<notes-root>" --only "<rel-path>"  # one note (sample stage; repeatable)
node assets/study-notes/scripts/check-library.mjs "<notes-root>" --json
`check-library.mjs` exits `0` = no errors (warnings may exist), `1` = errors, `2` = usage error. It checks:

- **Structure**: naming, frontmatter, required artifacts, per-chapter test (error) and cheat sheet (warning); directories starting with `_` or `.` are skipped.
- **Links**: standard links and images exist, anchors resolve to headings (tolerating Typora/GitHub punctuation differences), empty links, links escaping the root, unencoded spaces.
- **Portability**: `[[wikilink]]` / `![[embed]]` = error; `> [!x]` callouts, `> **Note**:`, single-line `$$`, multiple H1s = warning.
- **Teaching**: 3–5 exercises per section (only counting answer blocks under "本节练习"), ≤ 800 lines per note, ≤ 20 callouts, leftover old `C1-01` numbering, `【回顾 CX】` review questions from chapter 3 on.
- **Code**: fragments bound by `<!-- source: -->` / `<!-- output: -->` are compared line by line against the real files; "real output" claimed but unbound = warning.
- **Course line [R1]–[R11]** (warnings by default, errors under `--strict`):
  - [R1] section order is intro → 接上一节 → 3–5 steps → summary → exercises → concept index, and every step has "action → visible result → why";
  - [R2] a `## 接上一节` bridge (what the last section built / what it left open / what this section adds) and a closing "留给下一节" hook;
  - [R3

`run-course.mjs` is the machine version of the "read-in-order test": it calls `check-library.mjs --replay-to` to get the `project/` at every 【运行】, runs the commands there (stdout and stderr merged), strips machine-specific absolute paths, and compares with `code/out/`, ignoring traceback frames and timings. If Python is not found it skips with exit 0. **It executes the commands in the notes; run it only on libraries you wrote.**

Both scripts prove **mechanical consistency** and "following the text actually works". They cannot prove **that the content is correct**, nor whether a reader knows what to do next. That is a human pass driven by `assets/study-notes/references/quality-gates.md` and the manual read-in-order test in section 12 of `teaching-design.md`.

The R1–R11 rules of v2.0.0 guarantee that a reader can *follow* a section and build the artifact. In practice that is not enough: after such a section the reader may be able to name the next file to create, yet not say why the function exists or why it has to be written that way. v2.1 therefore adds a second line of rules, this time about the explanation itself:

| Rule | Requirement |
|---|---|
| T1 explain before you build | a step title is a question or a topic ("Why can't a batch of numbers be a Python list?"); before the first hands-on block there are at least 8 lines (usually 20–60) explaining why this step exists and why it cannot be written any other way |
| T2 concepts explained in place | a `### 概念 N` entry runs 40–120 lines: why it is needed → the same idea in maths or plain prose → one-sentence summary → definition → example → pitfalls. Not an API card |
| T3 predict first | at least one "先想一下 / 先猜一猜" per section; after the reveal, explain what a wrong guess missed |
| T4 read back | after every run, "刚才发生了什么" maps each line of output back to the explanation instead of pasting a result |
| T5 prose over code | prose is not shorter than the code: code is the practice part, not the skeleton |

**Important: in 2.1 the T1–T5 rules only ever report warnings; `--strict` does not promote them to errors.** The reason is that this repository's own fixtures and the existing libraries are still written as operation manuals, so enforcing them overnight would make migration impossible. Treat them as hard requirements when writing a new library; the next release can tighten them once the fixtures are rewritten in the four-beat form.

`templates/section-note.md` and `references/teaching-design.md` have been rewritten around the four beats (think → explain → build → read back), so a new library written from the template satisfies T1–T5 naturally.

---

readme.section: 6. 老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移 (migrating an existing library step by step)
readme.text: Libraries generated before v2.0.0 use a "concept card" skeleton: each section is a row of `## 概念 N：` blocks, and code is excerpted from a finished `code/` tree. The new checker raises **no new errors** on such libraries. It lists course-line problems as `[R*]` warnings, so you can migrate one section at a time instead of rewriting everything at once. For reference, three existing libraries checked read-only in default mode all had 0 errors and roughly 370, 220 and 250 course-line warnings.

readme.section: 6. 老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移 (migrating an existing library step by step)
readme.text:
**Before you start**: commit the library to git (or back it up). Migration rewrites a lot of text, and you need a way back.

**Step 0: see the debt.**

```bash
node assets/study-notes/scripts/check-library.mjs "<library>" --json > before.json
```

Count the findings per `[R*]` number to see which rules and which chapters carry most of the work.

**Step 1: fix the free ones first.** These do not touch the teaching structure and can be done library-wide in one pass:

readme.section: 6. 老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移 (migrating an existing library step by step)
readme.text:
- [R11] absolute paths: replace `C:\Users\…`, `D:\…`, `/home/…` in text, commands and saved output with paths relative to the notes root or `project/`. If a script prints paths, make it print relative paths and regenerate the output.
- [R8] notebooks: move them to `code/notebooks/CN_topic.ipynb` and clear their outputs.
- Portal formulas: copy `templates/web/index.html` **and the whole `templates/web/vendor/`** into `<library>/web/`.
  `index.html` alone still works, but offline it degrades formulas to source text; with `vendor/` (~1.3 MB) the portal renders formulas without network.

readme.section: 6. 老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移 (migrating an existing library step by step)
readme.text: **Step 2: migrate chapter by chapter, starting from chapter 1.** The bridge chain runs forward, so chapter N's "接上一节" depends on chapter N−1 already being migrated. For each chapter:

readme.section: 6. 老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移 (migrating an existing library step by step)
readme.text: 1. **Fix the line first (R9)**: in `00 大纲.md` and `checklist.md`, write the "本节产物" (artifact) for every section: what the reader has at the end of it and how they can check it. A section with no artifact was a concept card all along; merge it into another section or re-cut the chapter. 2. **Rebuild the section skeleton (R1/R2/R5/R10)**: add `## 接上一节` (上一节做到： / 留下的坑： / 本节补上：), make the intro state "你现在手上 / 本节结束时", cut the body into 3–5 `## 第 N 步：` steps that each name the action, the visible result and the reason, and end with 留给下一节：. Split sections longer than 800 lines or 5 steps. 3. **Move concepts into steps (R3)**: turn `## 概念 N：名称` into `### 概念 N：名称` and place it in the step that first needs it. **Keep the number**: the portal builds its concept badges and anchors from "概念 N：", and dropping the number breaks those links. While a migration is half done, mixing `##` and `###` across the library produces one [R3] "mixed styles" warning; that is expected and disappears when you finish. 4. **Turn finished code into the reader's own code (R4)**: - today's `code/` is the final version of the whole book. Put the state **at the end of this chapter** into

readme.section: 6. 老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移 (migrating an existing library step by step)
readme.text:
```bash

readme.section: 6. 老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移 (migrating an existing library step by step)
readme.text:
It follows the text from an empty directory, runs every 【运行】, and writes `code/out/`, the output blocks in the text and `code/answer/chNN/`. Read the generated output: **when it disagrees with the prose, fix the prose, not the output**. A replay failure (a 【修改】 whose context cannot be found) means the text cannot be followed as written; fix it at the reported line.
6. **Add the chapter ending (R6/R7)**: give the chapter's last section a "章末通跑" step (one command + bound real output) and a "本章项目地图" (a file tree containing `project/`, one line of responsibility per file, and "本章动了" listing the files this chapter touched).
7. **Accept the chapter**: run `check-library.mjs "<library>" --strict --only "<each section of this chapter>"`, then `run-course.mjs "<library>"`. The chapter is migrated when it has 0 errors and every output matches. Log it in the changelog of `checklist.md`.

readme.section: 6. 老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移 (migrating an existing library step by step)
readme.text: **Step 2 supplement: thicken the explanation (T1–T5).** Changing only the skeleton and not the prose yields sections that can be followed but teach nothing — exactly what v2.1 exists to fix. This pass touches neither code nor saved output; start it by running `check-library.mjs` to see where `[T1]`–`[T5]` point:

readme.section: 6. 老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移 (migrating an existing library step by step)
6. 老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移 (migrating an existing library step by step)
readme.text: **Step 3: accept the whole library.** When every chapter is migrated, run `check-library.mjs "<library>" --strict` and `run-course.mjs "<library>"`. When both pass, the migration is done. Finish with one manual read-in-order test of a chapter: follow only the literal instructions, in an empty `project/`, to the end of the chapter.

readme.section: 6. 老库怎么按新结构逐步迁移 (migrating an existing library step by step)
readme.text:
**Non-programming subjects** (maths, languages, history…) have no `project/` or `code/`, so the code parts of [R4]/[R6] do not apply. Follow items 1–3 and 6 of step 2: the artifact of a section becomes one more result in the derivation notebook, one more set of patterns in the sentence book, one more stretch of the timeline; the chapter smoke run becomes "re-derive / retell your own artifact from the start". Per-subject guidance is in `assets/study-notes/references/subject-playbooks.md`.

---

- **No external dependencies**: `index.js`, `serve.mjs`, `check-library.mjs` and `run-course.mjs` use only `node:` built-ins. Hence there is no `dependencies` and no `peerDependencies` in `package.json` — installing triggers no network access and is never rejected by the profile's DSH version compatibility check.
- **`inject = ['skills']`**: when the profile has no skill registry, the plugin stays quietly inactive instead of throwing.
- **`SKILL.md` is self-parsed**: the plugin reads the YAML frontmatter of `assets/*/SKILL.md` and takes `name` and `description` as the catalogue entry; `SKILL.md` is the single source of metadata and cannot drift. Adding a skill only requires another directory under `assets/` with a `SKILL.md`.
- **`resourceBase` exposes the real directory**: when the skill loads, the `skill` tool tells the model the absolute paths of `references/`, `templates/` and `scripts/`. The model copies large files (portal HTML, launchers) with shell commands instead of retyping them — cheaper on context and free of transcription errors.
- **Port probing in the launcher**: the `.bat` collects `netstat` lines containing **LISTENING** to decide whether the port is taken. Matchi

- The portal's **visual** layer is not covered by automated tests (no browser control); it needs manual confirmation.
- `check-library.mjs` counts question numbers and points in `CX 测试.md` using the `**N.（M 分）**` convention. If a test file uses another format it degrades to a warning ("cannot check automatically") instead of a false positive.
- Consistency between `notes_data.js` and the `.md` files is only checked **loosely** (first 10 meaningful characters of the stem, the sequence of points, the number of questions). Semantically equivalent but differently worded questions go unnoticed.
- `run-course.mjs` runs 【运行】 commands through the system shell (a leading `python` / `python3` is replaced by the detected or `--python` interpreter), with a 120-second timeout per command, and compares after stripping snapshot absolute paths and ignoring traceback frames and unittest timings. Output that depends on unseeded randomness, the network or a GPU will be reported as different: seed it, or present it as a ```` ```text ```` illustration and say so.
- Concept headings keep their number (`### 概念 N：名称`) because the portal derives concept badges and anchors from "概念 N："; unnumbered concept h
